description: This file defines the ReminderRegistry class, which manages grain reminders within the Orleans framework. It provides methods to register, unregister, and retrieve reminders, ensuring proper context and configuration.

classes.name: ReminderRegistry
classes.description: A sealed class that manages grain reminders, ensuring proper registration, retrieval, and unregistration within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: RegisterOrUpdateReminder
methods.description: Registers or updates a grain reminder with validation of input parameters and context.

methods.name: GetReminder
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reminder by name.

methods.name: GetReminders
methods.description: Retrieves all reminders for a given grain.

methods.name: EnsureReminderServiceRegisteredAndInGrainContext
methods.description: Ensures that the reminder service is registered and the context is valid.

methods.name: ValidateServiceProvider
methods.description: Validates that the service provider is correctly configured for reminders.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidContext
methods.description: Throws an exception if the grain is accessed outside a valid grain context.
